decision.rationale: The source run completed reliably but is invalid for selection. Its dataset lacked independent human authoring review, C2/C3 prompts leaked case gold labels, C3 did not use or bind the selected chunker corpus, and the condition/policy/prompt identities were incomplete. Preserve the outputs as diagnostic evidence, keep held-out unopened, create a human-reviewed exact-passage v1.2 seal, and rerun development with the corrected v2 boundary.
limitations: This is a corrected audit of preserved development outputs, not a new tutor run.
No C0-C3 policy or retrieval contrast is selection eligible.
Safe-grounded success, semantic citation completeness, reviewed context sufficiency, and pedagogy remain unresolved.
Citation source/page correctness and claim-source coverage do not prove semantic entailment.
The private v1.1 cases were synthetic transformations with no independent human authoring review.
The authorized provider uses disk context caching and provides no project-specific no-training guarantee.
The 104-case one-time course-tutor held-out split remains unopened.
